name: Galleonaire
description:
Galleonaire is an independent, fan-made Harry Potter knowledge quiz for iPhone and Apple Watch. Play a fifteen-question Classic ladder for a fictional million-galleon prize, or take a subject exam across the books, films and wider wizarding world.

The collection includes 1,304 unique questions: the original 1,000 plus 304 additions, all available in Classic. The exam pools contain 507 intermediate and 529 expert questions. Ten subjects each offer a 20-question, untimed O.W.L. and a 50-question N.E.W.T. with standard, extended or untimed options. Exam answers can be changed or revisited and are saved immediately; marks, full grades and explanations appear after submission. A timed exam continues while the app is closed or the Watch sleeps. New attempts are randomised, while resumed attempts keep their original questions and order.

Redesigned Statistics separates Classic records, topic performance and exam results. Earlier records are retained, with ambiguous old topics shown separately. Native controls, readable text, VoiceOver labels and independently adjustable music, effects and haptics support accessible play. Both platforms work independently offline; exam records remain on the device where they were created.

Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced.

Existing testers can install through TestFlight. The existing Community Beta invitation remains https://testflight.apple.com/join/52fmzweP. Requires iOS 17 or later and watchOS 10 or later.
whatToTest:
EXAM VOICEOVER FIX AND 40 MORE QUESTIONS

1,304 unique questions in the game, up from 1,264. This update adds 20 intermediate O.W.L. questions and 20 expert N.E.W.T. questions. There are now 507 intermediate and 529 expert exam-eligible questions (1,036 total). These belong to the same 1,304-question collection, not an additional separate total. All 40 additions also appear in Classic: intermediate items at prize levels 7 to 10 and expert items at levels 14 and 15, including the million-galleon question.

Each Classic game still has 15 questions. Each O.W.L. paper still has 20 questions; each N.E.W.T. paper has 50. All ten subjects support both qualifications. New papers randomise selection and answer order; saved papers retain their content and order.

The exam Next Question control now keeps a stable label instead of changing to Skip Question. Moving forward or back rebuilds the question controls and requests VoiceOver focus on the new question heading. Answer recording stays neutral. Unanswered questions can still be skipped with Next Question and revisited through Review Questions.

Also improved: answer choices expose one concise accessible label; unchanged timer checks no longer refresh the exam state; the long result reference is tucked behind Result Reference so scores and grades remain prominent.

Suggested feedback: use Next Question after both answered and unanswered questions in O.W.L. and N.E.W.T.; revisit and change an answer; save and resume; inspect results, explanations and Statistics. Please report any repeated or incorrect announcements. Simulator checks cannot establish physical-device VoiceOver speech timing.

The new independently written questions were checked against official Rowling essays and Warner Bros. production material, with exact-fact and similarity screening. Existing questions, saved attempts and statistics are retained. Timed papers continue while the app is closed or the Watch sleeps; extended and untimed options remain available.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Choose New Game for Classic or Exam Mode for the new qualifications. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and plays independently. Timed exams continue against a saved deadline while closed; extended and untimed alternatives are available. Answers and explanations are revealed after submission. Galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. The independently written question bank retains source notes and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
